purpose: Stage 2 ambient key-visual system showing ingredient texture and manufacturing logic as a background-integrated material field rather than a framed photograph.
master_format: 3:2 landscape, full-bleed web and Storybook image

series_lock.base_field: warm mineral ivory yogurt field with restrained low-frequency tonal variation
series_lock.medium: hybrid image: real photographic food and fiber microtexture integrated into a minimal matte graphic field
series_lock.composition: no bounded photo rectangle, no conventional tabletop scene, no people, no package, no typography, broad quiet negative space
series_lock.light: one soft directional source with preserved midtone and shadow detail; no dramatic rays or crushed blacks
series_lock.palette: mineral ivory, soft graphite, natural thyme green and honey amber only
series_lock.material_truth: actual yogurt density, cloth fiber, translucent whey, honey viscosity and thyme micro-fibers remain physically legible
series_lock.edge_behavior: all material textures emerge from and dissolve back into the background with no cutout edge
series_lock.retouching: natural asymmetry, small thickness variation and imperfect food texture; no uniform CGI gloss
series_lock.text_policy: no text, logo, label or watermark

frames.observable_result: cloth fibers rise inside an ivory yogurt field while a thin translucent whey layer drains downward and the remaining field becomes denser
thyme micro-fibers and honey viscosity surface from within the ivory field as a restrained amber-green subsurface bloom
one broad fold moves across the dense field and drags a limited amber-green ingredient ribbon without homogenizing it
a single furrow leaves one sharp ingredient trace, one translucent middle trace and one fading deep trace that continues into negative space

avoid: marble swirls or fully mixed marbling
ingredient color used as a full background

document_integration.evidence_boundary: These are directional ambient concept visuals. They explain separation, infusion, minimal folding and persistent trace; they are not evidence of a production recipe, SOP, sensory panel or finished food appearance.
